ModMetaData.name: Survive Collapses
ModMetaData.author: Jitby-Jones
ModMetaData.description:
Collapses that fill the ground with collapsed rocks (overhead mountain cave-ins) no longer erase whoever is standing underneath.
Instead of being instantly killed and deleted, pawns caught in such a collapse are buried under the collapsed rocks:
- Most survive with heavy crush injuries: crushed (destroyed) limbs, crushed organs, cracked bones and deep bruising. Mountain collapses are deadly, but survivable. - Some are killed. Their bodies stay buried under the rubble, mangled (missing limbs, crushed organs), so you can dig them out and give them a proper burial. - Survivors are pinned and forced down while buried, even with full pain immunity. The weight of the rubble slows their bleeding, but the clock is ticking. - Mine the collapsed rocks to free them. Rubble over your people (and the shortest way to reach it) is designated for mining automatically, and an alert tracks everyone still trapped.
Roof collapses that don't instantly kill in vanilla (constructed and thin rock roofs) are left untouched.
Armor (Combat Extended): with Combat Extended loaded, worn and natural armor protects the body parts it covers, using CE's per-part (locational) armor values. Protection scales damage down and lowers the death chance; body parts with blunt protection at or above masterwork cataphract level are immune. Without Combat Extended, armor does not reduce collapse damage (this can be changed in the mod settings).
Death chances, injury severity, bleeding while pinned, the armor threshold and more are configurable in the mod settings.
Safe to add to an existing save. Removing it while pawns are buried will lose those pawns.
